description: This file defines the interface for the WifiManager module in the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the WifiManagerInterface class with pure virtual functions for performing Wi-Fi management tasks (e.g., scanning, connecting, disconnecting, getting statuses) and event callbacks related to Wi-Fi state changes.

classes.name: WifiManagerInterface
classes.description: Abstract class defining the Wi-Fi management interface with methods for operations and event notifications

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves device-specific quirks related to Wi-Fi

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the connected network

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network with given parameters

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Starts an alternative WPS pairing process

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about paired SSID

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled
